task.title: P6-178: Unify duplicated error-prefix parsing and give search-error banner a data-failure seam
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-178. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**Two copies of one error-prefix table, and a sixth hand-rolled banner** (was `P6-012b`). `catalog.rs:132-141`'s `describe_error` parses the `validation:` wire prefix independently of `components/states.rs:100-113`'s `classify`, and `/catalog`'s own `search-error` banner (`catalog.rs:494-505`) remains a sixth hand-rolled banner with no `data-failure` seam. Unify the parsing and give the banner the seam.
